function.name: get_element_size
function.description: This function calculates and returns the size of a given region element. The size is determined based on the type of the region element.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the region element whose size is to be calculated.

function.return_type: INT, represents the size of the given region element in bytes.

function.name: init_region
function.description: This function initializes a region with a given type and sets the number of children to zero.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be initialized

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type to be assigned to the region

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful

function.name: clone_element
function.description: This function clones a region element. If the second parameter points to NULL, a new region element is allocated. Depending on the type of the original element, the function either directly copies the data, clones a path, or recursively clones combined elements. If any operation fails, the function cleans up and returns the error status.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Pointer to the original region element to be cloned

parameters.name: element2
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a region element. If *element2 is NULL, a new element is allocated. Otherwise, *element2 is assumed to point to a valid object, and its contents are replaced with the cloned data

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails, or other status codes depending on the failure

function.name: fuse_region
function.description: This function sets the type of the node in the region to the given mode, assigns the left and right elements to the combine structure in the node, and increments the number of children in the region by 2.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region where the node's type is set and the elements are combined

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Pointer to the left element to be combined in the node

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Pointer to the right element to be combined in the node

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode to be set as the type of the node in the region

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: GdipCloneRegion
function.description: This function clones a region and returns the status of the operation.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be cloned.

parameters.name: clone
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, where the cloned region will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the cloning operation. It can be InvalidParameter if the parameters are not valid, or OutOfMemory if memory allocation for the clone fails.

function.name: GdipCombineRegionPath
function.description: This function combines a region with a path according to a specified combine mode. It can replace the region data with the path data or fuse the region with the path.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be combined with the path

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Pointer to the path to be combined with the region

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode that determines how the region and path are combined

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return 'Ok' if the operation was successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the region or path is null, or 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails

function.name: GdipCombineRegionRect
function.description: This function combines a region with a rectangle using a specified combine mode. If the combine mode is 'Replace', it replaces the region data with the rectangle region. If the combine mode is not 'Replace', it fuses the region and rectangle region together.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be combined with the rectangle.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle to be combined with the region.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode in which the region and rectangle are to be combined.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the region or rectangle is NULL, or 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails.

function.name: GdipCombineRegionRectI
function.description: This function combines a region with a rectangle using a specified combine mode.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be combined.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle to be combined.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode to use when combining the region and rectangle.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the rectangle pointer is null.

function.name: GdipCombineRegionRegion
function.description: This function combines two regions based on the specified mode. If the mode is 'CombineModeReplace', it replaces the first region with the second one. Otherwise, it fuses the two regions together.

parameters.name: region1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first region to be combined

parameters.name: region2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second region to be combined

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode of combination. It can be 'CombineModeReplace' or any other valid CombineMode value

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are not valid, or 'OutOfMemory' if there is not enough memory to perform the operation

function.name: GdipCreateRegion
function.description: This function creates a new region and initializes it with an infinite rectangle.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a GpRegion structure. The function will allocate memory for a new GpRegion and store the address in this parameter.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It returns InvalidParameter if the input parameter is null, OutOfMemory if memory allocation fails, and the result of the init_region function otherwise.

function.name: GdipCreateRegionPath
function.description: This function creates a new region that is the result of a specified path. It initializes the region, clones the path, and handles any errors that may occur during these processes.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the path that will be cloned to create the new region.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: This is a double pointer to a GpRegion object. The function will allocate memory for a new GpRegion object and the pointer to this new object will be stored in the location pointed to by this double pointer.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return 'InvalidParameter' if the path or region pointers are NULL, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation for the new region fails, or 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipCreateRegionRect
function.description: This function creates a region that consists of a rectangle. It initializes the region, checks for errors, and if successful, assigns the rectangle's dimensions to the region's node element data.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the rectangle from which the region is to be created.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: This is a double pointer to the region that is to be created.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are null, and the status of the initialization operation if it fails.

function.name: GdipCreateRegionRectI
function.description: This function creates a rectangular region with integer coordinates.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: A pointer to the rectangle structure.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GpRegion structure. This receives the created region.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the function is successful, it returns Ok. If there is an error, it returns an error status code.

function.name: GdipCreateRegionHrgn
function.description: This function creates a new region that is a copy of the specified region and assigns it to the provided pointer. It handles memory allocation and error checking for the new region.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region to be copied.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a GpRegion object. This will be set to the newly created region.

function.return_type: GpStatus. It represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is Ok. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the error values.

function.name: GdipDeleteRegion
function.description: This function deletes a region and frees the memory allocated to it.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A pointer to the region to be deleted.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the region is null, otherwise returns 'Ok'.

function.name: GdipGetRegionBounds
function.description: This function retrieves the bounding box of a region. It ignores the graphics transform and handles cases where the region is infinite or empty.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region whose bounds are to be retrieved

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics context

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpRectF structure that receives the bounding box of the region

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters is null

function.name: GdipGetRegionBoundsI
function.description: This function gets the bounds of a region in integer format. It first checks if the rect parameter is not null, then it gets the bounds of the region and rounds the values to the nearest integer.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: This is the region whose bounds are to be determined.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: This is the graphics context.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is the rectangle structure where the bounds of the region will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns Ok. If the rect parameter is null, it returns InvalidParameter.

function.name: write_dword
function.description: This function writes a DWORD to a specific location and increments the offset.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: This is the location where the DWORD will be written.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: This is the offset at which the DWORD will be written. It is incremented after the write operation.

parameters.name: write
parameters.description: This is the DWORD that will be written to the specified location.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: write_float
function.description: This function writes a float value to a specific location and increments the offset

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the float value is to be written

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pointer to the offset at which the float value is to be written

parameters.name: write
parameters.description: The float value to be written

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value

function.name: write_element
function.description: This function writes the data of a region element into a buffer. The type of the element determines how the data is written. The function also keeps track of how much of the buffer is filled.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: The region element whose data is to be written into the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: The buffer where the data of the region element is written

parameters.name: filled
parameters.description: Keeps track of how much of the buffer has been filled

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything

function.name: write_region_data
function.description: This function writes the region data into a structure and returns the size of the data written. If the data parameter is null, it only calculates and returns the size.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region whose data is to be written

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data where the region data is to be written

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the size of the data written or to be written

function.name: GdipGetRegionData
function.description: This function retrieves the data of a region, checks if the buffer size is sufficient, and writes the region data into the buffer. It also calculates the required size for the buffer.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region from which data is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the region data is to be written.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer.

parameters.name: needed
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function stores the required size of the buffer.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters is NULL or 'InsufficientBuffer' if the buffer size is less than required. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'.

function.name: read_element
function.description: This function reads an element from a memory buffer, processes it based on its type, and updates the provided region and count accordingly.

parameters.name: mbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory buffer from which the element is read.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region that is updated based on the read element.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: Pointer to the node that is updated with the read element.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to the count that is incremented based on the read element.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be Ok, OutOfMemory, InvalidParameter, or GenericError.

function.name: GdipCreateRegionRgnData
function.description: This function creates a region from the specified region data.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the region data.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the region data.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a GpRegion object where the region will be created.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. If not, it returns an error status.

function.name: GdipGetRegionDataSize
function.description: This function calculates the size of the region data and stores it in the 'needed' parameter. It returns a status indicating whether the operation was successful or not.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region whose data size is to be calculated.

parameters.name: needed
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the calculated size will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if either of the parameters is NULL.

function.name: edge_list_reserve
function.description: This function reserves space for an edge list. If the requested count is less than or equal to the current capacity, it returns Ok. If the count is more than the maximum capacity, it returns OutOfMemory. Otherwise, it reallocates memory for the edge list to the new capacity and updates the capacity.

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: Pointer to the edge list for which space is to be reserved

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of elements to reserve space for in the edge list

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns Ok if successful, OutOfMemory if the operation fails due to insufficient memory

function.name: rgn_round
function.description: This function rounds a real number upwards after subtracting a constant offset.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The real number to be rounded

function.return_type: INT, representing the rounded value of the input real number

function.name: line_to_edge_list
function.description: This function converts a line defined by two points into a list of edges. It also checks and adjusts the edges based on the given bounds.

parameters.name: p1
parameters.description: The first point of the line.

parameters.name: p2
parameters.description: The second point of the line.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: A pointer to the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: A pointer to the list of edges to be filled.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: flat_path_to_edge_list
function.description: This function converts a flat path to an edge list. It iterates over the path data, identifies the start and line points, and adds them to the edge list. It also handles the closing of subpaths.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Pointer to the path to be converted

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangular bounds

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: Pointer to the edge list where the result will be stored

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation was successful

function.name: cmp_edges
function.description: This function compares two edges based on their 'y' values first and then 'x' values if 'y' values are equal. It returns a positive value if the first edge is greater, negative if the second edge is greater, and zero if both are equal.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the first edge to be compared.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the second edge to be compared.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the comparison between the two edges

function.name: edge_list_to_rgndata
function.description: This function sorts the edges, allocates memory for rgndata, translates edges into scans based on winding mode, and sets the properties of rgndata. It returns a status indicating if the operation was successful or if there was an out of memory error.

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: A pointer to the list of edges to be processed.

parameters.name: fill_mode
parameters.description: The fill mode to be used when translating edges into scans.

parameters.name: rgndata
parameters.description: A double pointer to the RGNDATA structure where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It returns 'Ok' if the operation was successful, 'OutOfMemory' if there was a memory allocation error.

function.name: get_path_hrgn
function.description: This function generates a region from a path. It first checks if the path has any data. If not, it creates a rectangular region with zero dimensions. If the path has data, it clones the path, flattens it, transforms it into an edge list, then into a scans list, and finally into a region. It handles memory allocation and deallocation for the intermediate data structures.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Pointer to the path from which the region is to be generated

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Pointer to the bounding rectangle for the path

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be generated

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails

function.name: get_region_hrgn
function.description: This function creates a region handle for a given region element and bounds. It handles different types of region data and combine modes.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Pointer to the region element structure

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle structure that specifies the bounds

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Pointer to the region handle that will be created

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be Ok, OutOfMemory, GenericError, or NotImplemented depending on the situation

function.name: GdipGetRegionHRgn
function.description: This function retrieves a handle to a region that is equivalent to the specified region. It also transforms the region if a graphics object is provided.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A pointer to the region for which to retrieve the handle.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: A pointer to a graphics object. If this parameter is not NULL, the function transforms the region by the transformation matrix of the graphics object before retrieving the handle.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the handle to the region.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the function returns Ok. If one of the input parameters is invalid, the function returns InvalidParameter.

function.name: GdipIsEmptyRegion
function.description: This function checks if a region is empty by getting the region bounds and comparing the width and height to zero.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be checked.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object used for drawing.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean value where the result is stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters are null, or the status of the 'GdipGetRegionBounds' function if it fails.

function.name: GdipIsEqualRegion
function.description: This function checks if two regions are equal using the graphics context provided. It also checks if the regions are infinite.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: First region to compare

parameters.name: region2
parameters.description: Second region to compare

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Graphics context used for comparison

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to store the result of the comparison

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if any parameter is NULL, or other status codes depending on the result of the region comparison and deletion operations

function.name: GdipIsInfiniteRegion
function.description: This function checks if a region is infinite or not. It ignores the graphics parameter.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be checked

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics, but it is ignored in this function

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to the result, it will be set to true if the region is infinite, otherwise false

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the function call. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters is NULL, otherwise returns 'Ok'

function.name: GdipIsVisibleRegionRect
function.description: This function checks if a specified region is visible within a rectangle. It also deletes the region object after checking.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to check

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X-coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y-coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Width of the rectangle

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Height of the rectangle

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to the result, TRUE if the region is visible, FALSE otherwise

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if parameters are null, or other status codes based on the result of GdipGetRegionHRgn function

function.name: GdipIsVisibleRegionRectI
function.description: This function checks if a given rectangular region is visible within the graphics object.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to check visibility for.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: The width of the rectangle.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: The height of the rectangle.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object to check visibility within.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean variable where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if either 'region' or 'res' is NULL.

function.name: get_region_bounding_box
function.description: This function calculates the bounding box for a given region element. It handles different types of region elements and different combine modes. It also takes into account whether the region is empty or infinite.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: The region element for which the bounding box is to be calculated.

parameters.name: min_x
parameters.description: Pointer to store the minimum x-coordinate of the bounding box.

parameters.name: min_y
parameters.description: Pointer to store the minimum y-coordinate of the bounding box.

parameters.name: max_x
parameters.description: Pointer to store the maximum x-coordinate of the bounding box.

parameters.name: max_y
parameters.description: Pointer to store the maximum y-coordinate of the bounding box.

parameters.name: empty
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean value indicating whether the region is empty.

parameters.name: infinite
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean value indicating whether the region is infinite.

function.return_type: void, as the function does not return a value but modifies the values pointed to by the parameter pointers.

function.name: point_in_region
function.description: This function checks if a point is within a specified region. The region can be of different types and the function handles each type differently.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: This is the region within which the point is being checked.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: This is the x-coordinate of the point being checked.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: This is the y-coordinate of the point being checked.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a boolean value where the result of the check is stored. If the point is within the region, the value is set to TRUE, otherwise it is set to FALSE.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return Ok if the operation was successful, or NotImplemented if the region type is not supported.

function.name: GdipIsVisibleRegionPoint
function.description: This function checks if a point is visible in a region after applying the specified graphics transformation. If the graphics transformation is not provided, it checks the point in the region as is.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region in which to check the visibility of the point.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the point.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the point.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: The graphics transformation to apply to the point before checking its visibility. If this is NULL, no transformation is applied.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: A pointer to a BOOL that receives the result. If the point is visible in the region, this is set to TRUE; otherwise, it is set to FALSE.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns Ok. If any of the input parameters is NULL, it returns InvalidParameter. If there is an error during the transformation or region operations, it returns the corresponding error status.

function.name: GdipIsVisibleRegionPointI
function.description: This function checks if a point is visible in a specified region. The point's coordinates are given as integers.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region in which visibility of the point is checked

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the point

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the point

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object used for rendering

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean value where the result is stored. TRUE if the point is visible, FALSE otherwise

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns Ok. If the operation failed, it returns one of the error statuses

function.name: GdipSetEmpty
function.description: This function empties a given region by deleting its elements and initializing it with empty rectangle data.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A pointer to the region to be emptied.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, whether it was successful or not.

function.name: GdipSetInfinite
function.description: This function deletes the existing region, initializes it as an infinite rectangle, and returns the status of these operations.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be set to infinite

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, whether it was successful or not

function.name: transform_region_element
function.description: This function transforms a region element based on a given matrix. The transformation depends on the type of the region element. It can handle empty rectangles, infinite rectangles, regular rectangles, and paths. If the transformation is successful, it returns Ok status.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: This is the region element that needs to be transformed.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is the transformation matrix that will be applied to the region element.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the transformation. If the transformation is successful, it returns Ok.

function.name: GdipTransformRegion
function.description: This function transforms a region using a specified matrix.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the region to be transformed.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the matrix to be used for transformation.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the transformation operation. Returns InvalidParameter if either region or matrix is NULL.

function.name: translate_region_element
function.description: This function translates a region element by the specified dx and dy values. The translation varies depending on the type of the region element.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: The region element to be translated

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The distance to translate in the x direction

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The distance to translate in the y direction

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: GdipTranslateRegion
function.description: This function translates a region by the specified dimensions.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be translated

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The horizontal translation dimension

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The vertical translation dimension

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, returns 'InvalidParameter' if the region is null, otherwise returns 'Ok'

function.name: GdipTranslateRegionI
function.description: This function translates a region by the specified dimensions.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be translated.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the translation vector.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the translation vector.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, whether it was successful or not.

function.name: get_region_scans_data
function.description: This function clones a region, transforms it, gets its handle, and retrieves its data. If the handle exists, it gets the region data and allocates memory for it. If the handle doesn't exist, it allocates memory for a region data header and a rectangle, and copies the rectangle to the buffer. It then deletes the cloned region and returns the status.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be cloned and transformed

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the matrix used for transforming the region

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer to the region data to be retrieved

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operations performed in the function

function.name: GdipGetRegionScansCount
function.description: This function retrieves the number of scans in a region and stores it in the 'count' parameter. It returns a status indicating whether the operation was successful or not.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Pointer to the region from which the scan count is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the scan count will be stored.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the transformation matrix applied to the region.

function.description: This function retrieves the set of rectangles that make up the region, transforms them by the specified matrix, and stores them in an array of rectangles.

parameters.description: Pointer to an array of rectangles to receive the scans.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to an integer to receive the number of scans.
